title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology, Part-Time
bio: Dr. Perry received her DMD from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine in 2011 and completed her General Practice Residency at the University of California, San Francisco in 2012. She has been the dental director at Mid-State Health Center in NH since 2014 where she works as a general dentist overseeing an oral health program that provides comprehensive dental care to all, regardless of ability to pay. She oversees outreach projects at local school and nursing homes and teaches 4th year dental students and dental assisting students. Perry is the current chairperson of the New Hampshire Oral Health Coalition's steering committee, has served as trustee for the Lakes Region on the NH Dental Society Board, and is an active member of the ADA, NHDS, LRDS, and NNOHA. In 2017, Perry received the Community Service Award from the NHDS and in 2020 she was recipient of the Public Service Award from the Bi-State Primary Care Association. Over the past several years she has served as the public health dentist representative on the NH DHHS Medicaid Adult Dental Benefit work group which played an integral role is developing the first ever dental benefit for NH Medicaid beneficiaries.
